notes.title: German Flood Relief Event
notes.notes:
We are following the events in the flooded areas with sadness and deep sympathy and are shocked how many people have lost their lives, their livelihood, or their life's work. Our thoughts are with those affected and their families who are still - after the water slowly recedes - holding out in uncertainty and fighting for their belongings. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32976304/63bba9aaf4ca1507294280aa242a612f8e88d72a.jpg[/img]

We are full of pride and admiration for the service of volunteers, farmers, firefighters, soldiers, police officers, and disaster services who are working day and night in the flooded areas and who are sacrificially working under the most adverse circumstances for the people in need. 

[h2]We do our part![/h2]

Together with our studios Massive Miniteam ([url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1002000/SPITLINGS/]Spitlings[/url]), Paintbucket Games ([url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1003090/Through_the_Darkest_of_Times/]Through The Darkest Of Times[/url]) and Honig Studios ([url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/853050/El_Hijo__A_Wild_West_Tale/]El Hijo - A Wild West Tale[/url]), we started a Steam event - [i][b]German Flood Relief[/b][/i] - where [b]20% of every purchase[/b] will be donated to [url=https://www.aktion-deutschland-hilft.de/en/]Aktion Deutschland Hilft[/url]. 

https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/HandyGames/sale/GermanFloodReliefEvent

Separately, [b]we are donating an additional 30,000 Euros[/b] to [i]Aktion Deutschland Hilft[/i]! As part of [i]Embracer Group[/i] and the [i]THQ Nordic[/i] family, it's natural for us to stand united even in hard times, give back, and make the world a better place.

The Steam event includes a total of 37 games and 5 DLCs - among them such hits as El Hijo - A Wild West Tale (Best German Family Game 2021, winner of the Goldener Spatz), Through The Darkest Of Times (multiple winner of the German Computer Game Award (DCP), German Developer Award (DEP) and Indie Award Nominee at Gamescom), Little Big Workshop, Clouds & Sheep 2, Spitlings, Aces of the Luftwaffe Squadrons or the Townsmen series.

 
[url=https://www.aktion-deutschland-hilft.de/en/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32976304/2c74bbc4cd68086b1bad53b4289c9f4ef252b0e8.png[/img][/url]
 

Aktion Deutschland Hilft is an alliance of renowned German aid organizations that works together to help people who have lost everything due to major disasters.

If you would like to help beyond German Flood Relief, or if you already have all of our games, you can do so quickly and easily on the site www.aktion-deutschland-hilft.de. The donations go directly to where they are needed.

Thank you and stay safe <3

notes.title: THE TOWNSMEN - A KINGDOM REBUILT DLC "The Seaside Empire" IS NOW AVAILABLE
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34599783/ba5a842c0282c8822190d5963d2a3623873be082.jpg[/img]

THE TOWNSMEN - A KINGDOM REBUILT DLC "The Seaside Empire" IS NOW AVAILABLE

Welcome, Your Majesty! A vast, wild land is just waiting to be colonized by your settlers! Send your architects and builders to design and set up your city. Send workers to cut down trees and mine ore. Make sure that your fields are planted on fertile soil to feed the hungry mouths of your citizens! The crown is yours: guide your people from their first steps in a small village to a gigantic medieval metropolis with hundreds of inhabitants.

Expand on the existing gameplay with new buildings, like the military castle that allows for easier defense, the coastal harbor that increases your trading capabilities, or the inn that helps you earn money for having the most beautiful town. A vast amount of new decorations and other useful buildings allow you to create the medieval seaside metropolis you have always dreamed of.

Listen to relaxing new songs and let yourself get carried away by the ambient of the Mediterranean coastline...

notes.title: No need to be salty!
notes.notes:
Picture this, your loyal subjects are living a happy and fulfilled life. Thanks to your rule, your city is thriving and lively. A subject arrives to bring you a message: the queen of the coast requests your assistance in her country. Your eyes wander off into the distance as you think of the crystal blue waters and soothing smell of lavender...

Now embark on your journey to build your Seaside Empire! 

Townsmen: A Kingdom Rebuilt: The Seaside Empire DLC is packed full of great features. Enjoy the new Mediterranean setting, build a harbor along the coast to increase your trade, and dive into the all-new story events. But be warned, you may find yourself being forced to make difficult decisions where your choices may bear dire consequences...

[previewyoutube=UBYXyM-MpOA;full][/previewyoutube]

Set out into foreign lands! Leave the Kingdom of old and settle in a new empire by the crystal clear water of the Mediterranean. Send your builders to plan and construct new settlements in a completely new environment with a fresh look and feel. Expand on the existing gameplay with all new buildings, like the [b]military castle[/b] that allows for easier defense, the [b]coastal harbor[/b] that increases the trade options, or [b]the Inn[/b] that helps you earn money for having a beautifully decorated town. A vast amount of [b]new decorations[/b] and other useful buildings allow you to build the medieval seaside metropolis you have always dreamed of.

The Seaside Empire DLC also adds another layer of gameplay with the introduction of [b]difficult moral choices and decisions[/b] in the new [b]short story events[/b]. Send your villagers on expeditions and adventures or help them with their daily life in a medieval town. Deal with new disasters and weather phenomena. Listen to relaxing new songs and let yourself get carried away by the ambient of the Mediterranean coastline.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34599783/12c5b5137fc2e11ad9d0e71f7f20838c5be79005.jpg[/img]

[b]Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] Completely new Mediterranean tileset including several new maps
[*] New scenery like beaches and vegetation
[*] 6 new scenarios
[*] 9 endless mode maps including 48 random story events
[*] Unique skins for all buildings
[*] Choice & Consequence story events
[*] 11 new buildings including 2 new castles
[*] 26 new decorations
[*] New songs for your enjoyment!
[/list]

Townsmen: A Kingdom Rebuilt: The Seaside Empire will be available in early 2020 on Steam!

notes.title: Update 2.1.5 released (more languages!)
notes.notes:
Hi

We are happy to release another update! ːsteamhappyː

We added support for [b]Russian[/b], [b]Portuguese [/b]and [b]Simplified Chinese[/b] as requested by many players.

Also we analyzed your feedback and:
[list]
[*] Rebalanced general upgrade costs and benefits
[*] Revised some missions to fix problems and tweak parts that might be too hard
[*] Reworked sandbox quests to fit better to the current situation and make them easier to achieve in general
[*] Made some tweaks to the UI and general polishing
[/list]

We hope you like the changes and are waiting for your feedback in the forums!

Thanks for playing!

Update: No special news for that but we released 2.1.6 which should fix a possible crash when you updated to 2.1.5 while certain buildings were under construction.

notes.title: Patch for pathfinding (2.1.3) released (and 2.1.4 hotfix)
notes.notes:
Hi

Since we got some reports of Townies standing around and doing nothing we tweaked the pathfinding algorithm and testing looks like it should solve the problems.
If you still have issues please report them in the forum!

We are working on more tweaks and features requested by you so stay tuned. :)

Thank you!

Update:
We also just released a hotfix for the crash happening in maps with only 1 season when hovering the mouse over the season icon.

notes.title: Update 2.12 released
notes.notes:
Hi
we released an update that should fix the problem that the game dosn't start on some machines.

That also includes the first hotfix that solved the missing dll problem on Windows 7 systems and the too fast scrolling on high end PCs.

We will keep investigating further problems that you report us.

Thank you!
